findings.title: Async function calls sync `fetch_rate` without await
findings.body: `converted_cents` is an async function that calls `fetch_rate` on line 16 without `await`, so the call returns a coroutine object instead of the `Decimal` rate. This will raise a runtime error when the multiplication is attempted. Mark `converted_cents` as async and await `fetch_rate`.
findings.suggestion:
rate = await fetch_rate(pair)
    return round(amount_cents * rate)

findings.title: Return type mismatch: int vs Decimal
findings.body: `converted_cents` declares a return type of `int`, but the multiplication `amount_cents * rate` produces a `Decimal` (since `rate` is `Decimal` per `fetch_rate`'s signature). This will raise a `TypeError` at runtime. Align the return type with the actual result or convert explicitly.

summary.problem: The new async function `converted_cents` misuses `fetch_rate` and returns a mismatched type, causing runtime errors.
summary.done_well: The function is clearly documented and integrates the new rate-fetching capability.
